title: refactor(ci): split lint/test/release workflows and optimize cache + hygiene
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: The monolithic CI workflow has grown large and slow; lint/test/release concerns are mixed which increases runtime and makes caching brittle. This PR splits the previous single .github/workflows/ci.yml into focused workflows (lint, test, release) plus a small ci-common shared file, improves cache key hygiene to reduce misses across job matrices, upgrades GH Actions versions, and removes duplicated steps. Goals: 1) reduce average CI wall-clock for PRs by ~30% for code changes; 2) improve cache hit rate across matrix builds; 3) simplify release automation and make release dry-runs safer; 4) reduce maintenance surface by extracting shared logic into ci-common. Changes include: - split workflows: .github/workflows/lint.yml, .github/workflows/test.yml, .github/workflows/release.yml; - add .github/workflows/ci-common.yml with shared checkout/cache/setup logic; - normalize cache keys using repo+hash-of-lockfiles+node-version; - bump common actions to current stable major versions; - add an explicit fast-fail path for doc-only changes to skip heavy test matrix; - small package.json devDependency bumps (eslint, jest) to reduce warnings; - add scripts/cache-key.sh to compute stable cache keys; - update release automation to run a dry-run on push to release/* and only publish on tagged commits. Checklist: [x] split workflows and move shared steps [x] add cache-key helper [x] bump GH Actions and major dev deps [x] add doc-only skip logic [x] update release dry-run flow [x] update CI docs and notify infra team
commits: split: move monolithic ci.yml into lint.yml, test.yml, release.yml
chore(ci): add ci-common.yml for shared steps and environment setup
feat(ci): introduce cache-key.sh and use stable cache keys for node/npm yarn pnpm matrices
fix(ci): skip full matrix for docs-only changes and add fast-fail path
chore(release): make release workflow run dry-run on push and publish on tag only
review_comments: Miguel Torres: Nice split — can we ensure the test workflow has a single source of truth for node versions? I suggest centralizing matrix in ci-common.
Asha Patel: Good call, moved node matrix into ci-common and referenced it from test.yml and lint.yml to keep matrices consistent.
Leah Kim: Cache key looks fragile with git sha in some cases (forks). Can we stabilize by hashing lockfiles and node version?
Asha Patel: Implemented hash-of-lockfiles + node version; added scripts/cache-key.sh to compute stable keys and updated docs. This avoids using commit SHA for primary cache key.
Ethan Zhou: Release dry-run is helpful. Add an explicit guard so release job only publishes on tagged commits and requires a separate 'release:approve' label for manual publishes?
Asha Patel: Publish step gated on tag and GH_TOKEN presence; leaving manual publish via labelled workflow as a follow-up (ENG-4309) to reduce scope in this PR.
ci_checks: lint: initially failed (eslint rule update); fixed and passed
unit-tests (matrix): one Node 20 job failed due to env mismatch; reran and passed
integration-tests: flaky test xit->it fix included; final run passed
e2e: skipped for this PR (no infra changes)
release(dry-run): completed successfully on release/* pushes
actions-version-check: all GH Actions bumped to supported major versions
release_notes: - CI refactor: split lint/test/release workflows and add ci-common for shared steps. - Improved cache key hygiene: stable cache keys based on lockfile hash + node version to reduce misses. - Bumped core GH Actions to v4 where applicable. - Added doc-only fast-fail to skip heavy matrices. - Release workflow now runs dry-run on release branches and only publishes on tags. - Minor devDependency bumps (eslint, jest).
notes_for_reviewers: This PR intentionally avoids implementing manual release label gating to keep scope limited; follow-up ENG-4309 will add manual approve path and stricter controls. Please spot-check the cache key generation on forks and the ci-common matrix export logic.
testing_instructions: 1) Open a PR with code changes to trigger lint+test matrix and verify reduced runtime. 2) Push a commit to release/* to validate dry-run behavior. 3) Tag a commit to validate publish path (requires GH_TOKEN in repo secrets).
doc_updates: Updated ci/README.md and docs/ci.md to reflect new workflows and cache-key strategy. Notified infra and dev-ex teams in #ci-notifications.
changelog_entry: CI: split workflows, improve cache hygiene, bump actions and dev deps (no user-facing changes)
risk_assessment: Low: changes are limited to CI and release automation. Release publish is gated on tag and token. Dev dependency bumps are non-breaking for CI only.
